note: 'the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together... to go out to battle against the children of Israel'
Benjamin won the first two days (20:21, 20:25) before Israel prevailed
'And the men of Israel went out to fight against Benjamin'
'Judah was routed before Israel'; Jehoash took Amaziah at Beth-shemesh
'Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth-shemesh'
Ben-hadad mobilized the Arameans and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel, in Ahab's reign
